posts.headline: Fifty-two editions deep and Thicks finally bought a receipt — Klint's Clipboard is 7-2 now, but 1026.8 points-for still means this ring is coasting on vibes, not production.
posts.detail: A title in 2025 bought this roster forever benefit of the doubt, but a 5.5 average finish and the league's modest scoring total for a top-two record says the pedigree is still bigger than the product.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is officially buried at 2-7, and the best résumé in Busters Anonymous history is now unrecognizable.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish — literally the gold standard of this league — has decomposed into 929.86 points-for and a last-place campaign that future draft rooms will study as a warning.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie quietly has the best record in the league at 8-1, and mjwithgoldhoops is done being a middle-tier afterthought.
posts.detail: 1269.1 points-for is the top scoring mark in Busters Anonymous, and a career 15-13 mark with a 4th-place average finish is about to get a serious upgrade if this keeps up — Bald Fraud erasure in progress.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is still bottom of the barrel at 2-7, and the name keeps getting more ironic by the week.
posts.detail: A career 4-10 record and a league-worst average finish of 12 is exactly the résumé this roster is building toward again, with 934.22 points-for doing nothing to argue otherwise.

posts.headline: Sasinci dropped to 4-5 and Big Head's title defense is now officially a corpse nobody's investigating anymore.
posts.detail: A 2024 ring and a 13-15 career record once made Alxgalvn a contender to fear, but 1026.66 points-for and a losing record says Milk Man is spending more time threatening to quit than scoring points.
